items.question: Which goddess bearing a trident-weapon and sword is the proper object of worship?
premises: A goddess holds a trident-weapon in her hand.
The same goddess holds a sword.
The speaker declares worship of that goddess.
items.inference: The goddess identified by holding a trident-weapon and a sword is the one to be worshipped.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the goddess is implied by context rather than named in this verse.
items.plain_english: I worship her who indeed holds a trident-weapon in her hand and bears a sword.
